name: Kairi
source:
In order to pursue her lifetime dream of being a famous Idol, Kairi just moved to Akihabara, where she's been rejected by around fifteen Idol agencies already. On the brink of depression and with a lot of debts to pay already, a very weird and unconventional lifetime opportunity seems to appear right before her eyes...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1604800/]Steam[/url]]
